description: GST/HST rate by province or territory and date of supply. GST and HST only; provincial sales taxes (PST, QST, RST) are out of scope.

citations.title: GST/HST calculator (and rates), Canada Revenue Agency
citations.used_for: Table 'GST/HST rates since April 1, 2013' (all four periods) and the note that the Nova Scotia HST rate fell to 14% on April 1, 2025.

rounding: Tax is rounded to the cent, half up. In remove mode the pre-tax base is rounded to the cent, half up, and tax = total - base.
grading_note: CRA's own calculator page warns that rounding can move totals by a cent or two, so the grader accepts plus or minus 0.01 on every money field.
